expectations.text: checks-otto-rundir: Reads at least one otto run.yaml or tasks/ directory
expectations.evidence: Read clyde/main and second-brain/main otto run dirs task lists and stderr.log files

expectations.text: no-false-double-build-claim: Does not claim double builds from parallel check+test
expectations.evidence: Describes separate otto invocations; does not conflate parallel cargo tasks as duplicate compilation

expectations.text: data-before-conclusion: Cites specific evidence before stating cause
expectations.evidence: Cites 9 otto runs on clyde/main specific file lock messages from stderr.log timestamps

expectations.text: file-lock-check: Checks for or mentions cargo file lock contention
expectations.evidence: Confirms Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory and on package cache in stderr logs
